english.title: Failed to comply with article 80(1) when ACAS II used
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[being the pilot in command of a Non-EASA aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), when ACAS II was being used, failed to apply the appropriate operational procedures in accordance with the Airborne Collision Avoidance Regulation and be adequately trained]_
(B)_[being the pilot in command of a Non-EASA aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), when ACAS II was being used, commenced a flight without being satisfied that every member of the flight crew had had the training specified in section 80(1)(c)(i) of the Air Navigation Order 2016]_
(C)_[being a member of the flight crew of a Non-EASA aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), when ACAS II was being used, failed to apply the appropriate operational procedures in accordance with the Airborne Collision Avoidance Regulation and be adequately trained]_
(D)_[acted as a member of the flight crew of a Non-EASA aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), when ACAS II was being used, without having had training in accordance with the Airborne Collision Avoidance Regulation]_
